name: elastic-drawer-curtain
title: Elastic Drawer Curtain
description: A lateral drawer with an elastic pull string that deforms under user drag before parting cleanly from the screen edge.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Lateral Draw Pull: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
